about: Corrections to unitedstates/congress-legislators leadership_roles, applied by scripts/ingest/members.mjs until the dataset itself has the change. Each needs an official source. Entries that share a 'group' are one correction on the public log (/corrections, built by lib/corrections.js). reported_upstream: link to the issue or pull request filed with congress-legislators, or null if not yet reported. When the members job logs that the dataset already matches, set 'retired' to that date instead of deleting the entry, so the public log keeps it; retired entries are no longer applied.
